name: notely-monorepo
description: Production Full-Stack MERN Notes & Workspace SaaS Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
